verify.title: Verification
verify.verdict_ok_detail: The document you are viewing is identical to the one sealed during the count.
verify.verdict_warning_detail: The fingerprint matches the record, but the digital signature does not cover the whole document.
verify.axis_integrity_detail: Its fingerprint matches the one sealed on blockchain
verify.axis_signature_bad_detail: The signature does not cover the whole document
verify.coverage_ok: The signature covers the whole document. Nothing was added or changed after signing.
verify.coverage_bad: Content was added to the PDF after the last signature. The hatched portion is not covered by any signature.
verify.location: Where the station was set up
verify.axis_signature_none_detail: This document carries no electronic signature
verify.verdict_unsigned_detail: Matches what was sealed in blockchain. Carries no electronic signature.
verify.no_signature: The document contains no electronic signature, so there is no signer to show.

results.title: Results
results.heading: Results
results.source: Figures taken from the info field sealed with the tally sheet. They do not come from this page: they are the ones recorded at the time of the count.

share.title: Share this tally sheet
share.note: The verifier link is shared, not the file. Whoever receives it can check for themselves that the sheet is authentic.
share.message: Tally sheet for polling station {table} — {process}. Verified on blockchain.

pending.title: Your tally sheet is still on its way
pending.detail: The code is correct. A tally sheet does not become verifiable as soon as the count ends: it goes through several stages first.
pending.retry: Save this link or scan the same code again later. The sheet will appear here once it is registered.
pending.footer: Save this link or scan the same code again whenever you like. The sheet will appear here as soon as it is registered.
pending.body: The code is correct. A tally sheet does not become verifiable the moment counting ends: it goes through several stages first.

errors.not_found: No tally sheet was found for that code.
errors.unavailable: The service is unavailable right now. Please try again in a few minutes.
errors.no_code: Scan the QR code printed on the tally sheet to look it up.

state.not_found_title: We could not find this tally sheet
state.not_found_lead: The code in this link does not match any registered sheet.
state.not_found_note_typo: If you typed the address by hand, scan the QR code again: a single different character invalidates it.
state.not_found_note_damaged: If the printed code is torn or blurred, the camera may have misread it. Try again in better light.
state.not_found_note_pending: If counting has just finished, the sheet may not be published yet. Try again later.
state.no_code_lead: This page shows one specific tally sheet and needs to know which.
state.no_code_note_where: The QR code is printed on the tally sheet. Point your phone camera at it and open the link.
state.unavailable_title: We could not look up the sheet
state.unavailable_lead: The verification service did not answer. Nothing is wrong with the sheet: the system querying it is what failed.
state.unavailable_note: Try again in a few minutes. The link will still work later.
